  SHADOWED POLICY DETECTION
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  A policy is shadowed when an earlier rule with broader match criteria
  will always be evaluated first, making the later policy unreachable.

  ✅ No shadowed policies detected.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  DUPLICATE POLICY DETECTION
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Duplicate policies share the same srcintf, dstintf, srcaddr,
  dstaddr, service, and action. The second entry is redundant.

  ✅ No duplicate policies detected.
